page.notes: The first word of the page is set in italic and continues from the previous page. The Greek word στίχος is doubtful in the scan; I read it as στίχος with [?]. The running head "PRÆFATIO" is printed in small capitals with the Æ ligature. The catchword "mi" is a partial word at the bottom right, probably the start of "primi", and is doubtful. The Latin long s is rendered as plain s throughout, and f in "afferit" and "fit" is read as s ("asserit", "sit"). Some words are italic in the scan, which I have marked where they are clearly set in italic; the italics in the first paragraph are approximate.
